diagnosis: preexisting_pre_hardening_teacher_dev_output_collided_with_fail_closed_output_root; observed metrics are stale historical artifacts rather than evidence from the newly submitted hardened run
reusable_lessons: A fail-closed evaluator should never overwrite old evidence, but its output namespace must version with receipt/schema semantics.
Artifact presence and schema version are cheap provenance fingerprints for distinguishing a fresh run from stale outputs.
Do not diagnose a model from metrics until the expected run-specific receipt/preflight proves those metrics belong to the intended execution.
When an output collision occurs, preserve historical evidence and allocate a new deterministic namespace instead of deleting or mutating prior results.
